```sql
with periods(key, start_date, end_date, sort_order) as (
    values
        ('week_before', date '2026-08-24', date '2026-08-30', 1),
        ('last_week',   date '2026-08-31', date '2026-09-06', 2)
),
scope_orders as (
    select p.key,
           p.sort_order,
           o.order_id
    from periods p
    join orders o
      on o.business_date between p.start_date and p.end_date
    join showrooms s
      on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where not o.is_test
      and s.country_code in ('GB')
),
attempted_orders as (
    select so.key,
           so.sort_order,
           so.order_id,
           max(case when a.status = 'captured' then 1 else 0 end) as succeeded
    from scope_orders so
    join payment_attempts a
      on a.order_id = so.order_id
    where not a.is_test
    group by so.key, so.sort_order, so.order_id
)
select key,
       cast(sum(succeeded) * 1.0 / count(*) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from attempted_orders
group by key, sort_order
order by sort_order
```
